_about: Deliberately poisoned tailored resumes. Each case changes one line of the clean sample resume. The 'code' cases contain something the deterministic guard can prove is absent (a number, a skill-list entry, an id). The 'semantic' cases pass the code guard on purpose: only the validator model can catch them. 'clean' cases contain no fabrication and must pass.
